propositions: Import documentation describes 256-event batching for independent create, parent, file-impact, verify-command, and comment passes while link and status passes remain per-event.
Import batching provides no whole-file atomicity and does not automatically repair or complete partial imports after a crash between passes.
Deferred push occurs after successful import work, and source-based serial resumption supports skipping via source_id.
Concurrent duplicate risk exists when import scans race, and incomplete tickets can result from crashes between passes.
Generated CLI help and reference must regenerate from canonical parser help via gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py without changing importer runtime behavior.
User guidance explicitly states the lack of automatic repair, whole-file atomicity, partial-result risk, and concurrent-import limitations.
